note: The questions of the live run of the generative mode (scripts/rag/live-run.ts). 15 in Vietnamese, 15 in English; `field` is a demo field whose context and telemetry go with the question; `expect` says what a right answer does: `answer` (gives the figures), `no-data` (says the data is missing and why), `declined` (the router declines, the model is not asked), `router` (the router answers by rule that the species is not in the atlas, the model is not asked).
